question.text: A mosquito $O$ is sitting infront of a glass rod having spherical end of radius of curvature $40 \mathrm{~cm}$. The image would be formed at

solution.text:
As, we know, $\frac{\mu_2}{v}-\frac{\mu_1}{u}=\frac{\mu_2-\mu_1}{R}$
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \Rightarrow \quad \frac{1.5}{v}-\frac{1}{(-20)}=\frac{1.5-1}{+40} \\
& v=-40 \mathrm{~cm} \\
&
\end{aligned}
$$
Negative sign shows that image is obtained on the same side of object i.e., towards left.
